title: Global night-sky brightness index (2011 = 100)

source.name: Citizen scientists report global rapid reductions in the visibility of stars from 2011 to 2022
source.publisher: Kyba et al., Science (2023), via Globe at Night citizen-science data

notes: Illustrative index compounding the study's measured global average rate of night-sky brightening -- 9.6% per year, 2011-2022, from Globe at Night citizen star-counts -- forward from a 2011 baseline of 100. The 9.6%/year rate itself is the peer-reviewed, published figure; the index path between years is a straight compounding of that rate, not independently measured year by year.
